summary: Tracy has repeatedly and explicitly defended Israel's military conduct in Gaza. In a December 2025 interview he stated he supports Israel's actions there; as ILGOP Chairman in January 2024 he called a Chicago City Council ceasefire resolution 'posturing theatrics' and a 'slap in the face to the hostages.' He demanded sixteen Illinois legislators who refused to condemn the October 7 Hamas attack be disqualified from office, and in June 2026 praised the Trump administration's handling of the U.S.-Israel-Iran war.
